title: Deterministic Intent Translation: Implementation, Benchmarks and Reproducibility Artifacts
description: Reference implementation, frozen benchmarks, experiment runners and per-case evidence supporting the article 'Deterministic Failure Containment for Hallucination-Resistant LLM-Based Intent Translation in Network Slicing'. Includes the five-predicate validation cascade, the 120-case held-out benchmark, the multi-model robustness sweep (Study A), the constrained-decoding comparison (Study B), and the confirmatory rerun artifacts.
